items.example: Eunice is a stunt double in films.
There's a great stunt in which his car has to jump across a fifteen-metre gap.
She started doing stunt work over fifteen years ago.
Now she works more as a stunt director.
Crashing a car at high speed is part of the job.
She jumped off ships and fallen off buildings.
She has fallen off buildings in films.
She has broken some bones during her career.
Broken bones and other injuries are normal for stunt doubles.
She woke up with a few aches and pains.
Most stunt performers talk about the excitement and the challenge.
It was the most memorable moment in her life.
He was running towards the bridge.
Move away from the building — it's dangerous.
They walked across the bridge together.
The boat went under the bridge.
